hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5, the N=64 to N=128 trained force R2 drop also appears on data_seed 1. Setup: N=128 seeds 20-21, otherwise identical to the paired data_seed 1 N=64 m2-fixed arm proposed this cycle. Trained force R2 falls by >= 0.05 against the same seed's N=64 value, while the force control R2 changes by <= 0.03. Both values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, paired per seed, with the layer reported. If the best-margin layers differ between arms, the control comparison is flagged as cross-layer. If the paired arm is unavailable, the comparison is reported as not computed.
expected_if_true: In both seeds, trained force R2 drops by >= 0.05 from N=64, |control change| <= 0.03, and the accel_step headroom-normalised margin stays in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: In at least one seed, trained force R2 changes by <= 0.02 from N=64. That would make the m2-fixed decodability loss specific to data_seed 0. Seeds that disagree, or drops between 0.02 and 0.05, are inconclusive.
